system.notes:
A thin man cloaked in once-bright robes smiles widely beneath his hood. He carries a bone-white flute in knuckled hands, trilling and warbling as he meanders through the streets. Children flock to his songs, but their scolding mothers pull them back through tightly shuttered doors. A few days after The Piper passes, rats become restless and vicious. Cats are found with their throats torn out, and disease festers in the streets.

AC 14 (leather armor), HP 49, ATK 2 discordant note (near) +9 (1d8) and 1 sever shadow +7 and 1 puppetry, MV near (climb), S +2, D +3, C +4, I +3, W +2, Ch +5, AL C, LV 10

Cursed Flute. The Piper carries a magical flute that grants him the below talents. He can use each once per encounter. If a humanoid creature bears the flute for 2d6 days, that person becomes The Piper. Ratsplosion: Summon a loyal swarm of rats (Shadowdark RPG pg. 245). If common folk are nearby, up to 2d6 of them melt down into these rats. Dissolve Into Rats: If The Piper goes below 10 HP, he explodes into a swarm of rats and flees. The one albino rat in the swarm is The Piper.

Pay The Piper. If you don’t pay The Piper for an agreed-upon debt, a curse strikes you in 1d4 days. You suddenly rise and dance out of town into the wilderness as far as you can go for 2d4 days without rest.

Puppetry. One target in near. DC 15 CHA or use next action to attack ally.

Sever Shadow. The target creature’s shadow peels off and becomes a hostile shadow (Shadowdark RPG pg. 250).

Art by Yuri Perkowski-Domingos, 2023. “Legend of The Piper” adapted from @Grognard
